name: Lokalise
description: Lokalise translation management: projects, keys and translations, languages, contributors, translation and review tasks, file exports as background processes, comments, screenshot metadata, branches and the glossary. Lokalise API v2 with an API token.
instructions:
## Lokalise
This connector works with the **Lokalise API v2** (`https://api.lokalise.com/api2`): projects, keys and translations, languages, contributors, tasks, file exports, comments, screenshot metadata, branches, glossary terms and custom translation statuses. Lokalise also runs its own MCP server in beta (`https://mcp.lokalise.com/mcp/project-management` and `/mcp/software-development`, OAuth or an `apikey` header).

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. In Lokalise open your **profile > API tokens** and generate a token. A read-only token is enough for the reading tools; the writes need a read and write token.
2. Paste it into `LOKALISE_API_TOKEN`. It is sent in the `X-Api-Token` header and acts with your rights in each project.
3. Run `lokalise_list_projects` to check the token.

**Workflow**
- Orientation: `lokalise_list_projects` (with `include_statistics: 1` for progress per language), `lokalise_get_project`, `lokalise_list_project_languages`, `lokalise_list_system_languages` for ISO codes, `lokalise_list_translation_statuses`.
- Keys and translations: `lokalise_list_keys` (with `include_translations: 1` to see the texts; filter by name, tag, file, platform, untranslated or QA issues), `lokalise_get_key`, `lokalise_list_translations` (filter by language, reviewed, unverified, untranslated or task) and `lokalise_get_translation`.
- Change content: `lokalise_create_keys` (new strings with their source text), `lokalise_update_key`, `lokalise_bulk_update_keys`, `lokalise_update_translation` (text plus reviewed or unverified flags), `lokalise_add_languages`.
- Team and work: `lokalise_list_contributors`, `lokalise_get_contributor`, `lokalise_get_my_contributor`, `lokalise_add_contributors` (sends invitations); `lokalise_list_tasks`, `lokalise_get_task`, `lokalise_create_task` (translation, review or automatic_translation for some keys and languages), `lokalise_update_task` (`{"close_task": true}` closes it).
- Export files: `lokalise_download_files` starts an export and returns a `process_id`; call `lokalise_get_process` until `status` is `finished` and hand the `details.download_url` zip link to the user (it expires after a while). `lokalise_list_files` shows the files of the project. Uploading files needs base64 content and is not part of this connector.
- Context: `lokalise_list_project_comments`, `lokalise_list_key_comments`, `lokalise_add_key_comments`, `lokalise_list_screenshots`, `lokalise_get_screenshot`.
- Branches and glossary: `lokalise_list_branches`, `lokalise_create_branch`; `lokalise_list_glossary_terms`, `lokalise_get_glossary_term`, `lokalise_create_glossary_terms`, `lokalise_update_glossary_terms`.

**Switched off at install**: `lokalise_delete_key`; it cannot be undone, so an admin switches it on when the team needs it.

**Ids**: project ids look like `767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127`; to work on a branch pass `<project id>:<branch name>`. Key, translation, task, language and user ids are numbers. Languages are ISO codes such as `en`, `de`, `pt_BR`.

**Reading the answers**: list answers wrap the items (`projects`, `keys`, `translations`, ...). Times come as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (Etc/UTC)` plus a Unix `..._timestamp`. Plural translations are JSON strings with the forms (`one`, `other`, ...). Flags in filters are `0` or `1`.

**Paging**: `limit` and `page`; the totals come in the `x-pagination-total-count` and `x-pagination-page-count` headers, shown under `_headers`. Keys and translations also accept `pagination: cursor`: pass the `x-pagination-next-cursor` header value as `cursor` until it is missing. Glossary terms page with `cursor` only.

**Limits and errors**: 6 requests per second per token and per IP address, and at most 10 requests in flight per project; 429 means slow down. 401 is a wrong token, 403 a read-only token used for a write or missing project rights, 404 an unknown project or item, 400 a validation error with the field named in the message.
prerequisites: A Lokalise account and an API token from your profile (read-only for reading, read and write for changes).

LOKALISE_API_TOKEN.label: API token
LOKALISE_API_TOKEN.help: Lokalise > profile picture > Profile settings > API tokens > Generate new token (read-only or read and write). Sent in the X-Api-Token header.
LOKALISE_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: A Lokalise API token is a string of 40 letters and digits; paste only the token.

verifyHints.400: Lokalise says the X-Api-Token header is invalid: paste the 40-character token itself, without spaces or quotes.
verifyHints.401: Lokalise refused the token. Generate a new one under Profile settings > API tokens.
verifyHints.403: The token cannot do this: use a read and write token for changes, and check your rights in the project.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Lokalise allows 6 requests per second per token and 10 concurrent requests per project. Wait a moment and try again.

tools.name: lokalise_list_projects
tools.description: Projects the token can reach, with id, name, type (localization_files, paged_documents, ...), base language, team and, on request, statistics (progress, keys, words per language) and settings.

filter_team_id.description: Only projects of this team id.

tools.name: lokalise_get_project
tools.description: One project with its settings and statistics: progress, keys, words and QA issues per language, base language and team.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_list_keys
tools.description: Translation keys of a project with name per platform, description, tags, filenames and, with include_translations 1, the translations. Filter by key name, tag, filename, platform, language, untranslated or QA issues. Supports cursor paging (pagination cursor) for large projects.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

filter_platforms.description: Comma-separated platforms: ios, android, web, other.

filter_untranslated.description: 1 for keys with at least one untranslated language.

filter_translation_lang_ids.description: With include_translations: only these language ids, comma-separated.

disable_references.description: 1 to return key references as they are, not resolved.

cursor.description: The x-pagination-next-cursor header value of the previous page, with pagination cursor.

tools.name: lokalise_get_key
tools.description: One key with all its translations, tags, platforms, filenames, description, context, character limit and custom attributes.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_create_keys
tools.description: Create one or more keys, with their translations if known. Each key needs key_name and platforms.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

keys.description: Keys, e.g. [{"key_name": "checkout.title", "platforms": ["web"], "description": "Checkout page title", "tags": ["checkout"], "translations": [{"language_iso": "en", "translation": "Checkout"}]}]. key_name may also be {"ios": ..., "android": ..., "web": ..., "other": ...}.

use_automations.description: Run the project's automations (machine translation and so on) on the new translations.

tools.name: lokalise_update_key
tools.description: Update a key's name, description, platforms, filenames, tags (merge_tags to add rather than replace), plural settings, hidden or archived flag, context or character limit.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

key.description: Fields to change, e.g. {"description": "Shown on the cart", "tags": ["cart"], "merge_tags": true, "char_limit": 40, "is_archived": false}.

tools.name: lokalise_bulk_update_keys
tools.description: Update several keys in one call. Each entry carries key_id and the fields to change, including translations.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

use_automations.description: Run the project's automations on changed translations.

tools.name: lokalise_delete_key
tools.description: Delete a key and all its translations from a software project.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_list_translations
tools.description: Translations of a project, one row per key and language, with the text, reviewed and unverified flags, custom statuses, words and modification time. Filter by language, reviewed, unverified, untranslated, QA issues or active task.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

filter_active_task_id.description: Only translations in this task id.

cursor.description: The x-pagination-next-cursor header value, with pagination cursor.

tools.name: lokalise_get_translation
tools.description: One translation by id: key, language, text, reviewed and unverified flags, custom statuses, word count and who changed it last.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_update_translation
tools.description: Change the text of one translation and its reviewed, unverified or custom status flags. Plural keys take a JSON string with the forms.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

translation.description: The new text. For a plural key a JSON string such as {"one": "1 item", "other": "%d items"}.

custom_translation_status_ids.description: Custom translation status ids to set.

tools.name: lokalise_list_project_languages
tools.description: Languages of a project with lang_id, lang_iso, name, right-to-left flag and plural forms.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_add_languages
tools.description: Add languages to a project by ISO code, e.g. de or pt_BR, optionally with a custom code or name.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_list_system_languages
tools.description: All languages Lokalise supports, with lang_id, lang_iso, name and plural forms. Use it to find the right ISO code.

tools.name: lokalise_list_contributors
tools.description: Contributors of a project with email, name, admin and reviewer flags, role and the languages each may translate or review.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_get_contributor
tools.description: One contributor of a project by user id, with rights and languages.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_get_my_contributor
tools.description: The token owner as a contributor of a project: user id, rights and languages. Useful to know whose name writes go under.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_add_contributors
tools.description: Invite people to a project by email with their languages and rights. They receive an invitation email.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

contributors.description: Contributors, e.g. [{"email": "translator@example.com", "fullname": "Ana", "languages": [{"lang_iso": "es", "is_writable": true}], "role_id": 3}]. Role ids 1 to 5 map to the role templates (see the Lokalise docs).

tools.name: lokalise_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks of a project with title, status, type (translation, review, automatic_translation, lqa_by_ai), due date, languages with assignees and progress.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

filter_statuses.description: Comma-separated statuses: created, queued, in_progress, completed.

tools.name: lokalise_get_task
tools.description: One task with its languages, assignees, keys count, progress, closing tags and settings.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_create_task
tools.description: Create a translation or review task for some keys and languages, assigned to users or groups, with a due date. automatic_translation uses machine translation.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

due_date.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in UTC.

source_language_iso.description: Source language, default the base language.

auto_close_languages.description: Close a language when all its items are done.

auto_close_task.description: Close the task when all languages are done.

closing_tags.description: Tags added to the keys when the task closes.

do_lock_translations.description: Lock the translations to the assignees while the task is open.

parent_task_id.description: Parent task id, for a review task following a translation task.

tools.name: lokalise_update_task
tools.description: Change a task's title, description, due date, languages or assignees, its auto-close settings, or close it with close_task.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

task.description: Fields to change, e.g. {"due_date": "2026-12-01 18:00:00", "languages": [{"language_iso": "de", "users": [421]}]} or {"close_task": true}.

tools.name: lokalise_list_files
tools.description: Files of a project with filename, key count and the date they were last imported.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_download_files
tools.description: Start an export of the project's translations as language files (json, xliff, strings, xml, po, yaml, ...). Returns a process_id: poll lokalise_get_process until status is finished, then use details.download_url (a zip). Read-only for the project, although it is a POST.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

format.description: File format, e.g. json, json_structured, xliff, strings, stringsdict, xml, po, yaml, csv, xlsx, arb, properties.

original_filenames.description: Keep the files as uploaded (default true); false bundles by bundle_structure.

bundle_structure.description: Path pattern when original_filenames is false, e.g. locale/%LANG_ISO%.json.

filter_data.description: Only translations with these states: translated, untranslated, reviewed, reviewed_only, last_reviewed_only, verified, nonhidden, nonarchived.

exclude_tags.description: Leave keys with these tags out.

export_empty_as.description: What to do with empty translations.

plural_format.description: Plural format, e.g. i18next_v4 or icu.

placeholder_format.description: Placeholder format, e.g. icu, printf, ios.

filter_task_id.description: Only the keys of this task.

tools.name: lokalise_get_process
tools.description: Status of a background process (file download or upload): queued, running, finished or failed, with details; for a download, details.download_url is the zip to fetch.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_list_project_comments
tools.description: All comments of a project, with the key they belong to, author and time.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_list_key_comments
tools.description: Comments on one key, with comment id, text, author and time, newest first.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_add_key_comments
tools.description: Add one or more comments to a key, e.g. a question to translators or context for a string.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

comments.description: Comments, e.g. [{"comment": "This is the button label, keep it under 20 characters."}].

tools.name: lokalise_list_screenshots
tools.description: Screenshots of a project (metadata only): title, description, URL, size, tags and the keys linked to them.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_get_screenshot
tools.description: One screenshot's metadata: title, description, URL, width and height, tags and linked key ids.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_list_branches
tools.description: Branches of a project with branch id, name and creation time. Use project_id:branch_name in other tools to work on a branch.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_create_branch
tools.description: Create a branch of a project (a copy of the main content to change in isolation and merge later).

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_list_glossary_terms
tools.description: Glossary terms of a project with description, case sensitivity, translatable and forbidden flags, translations and tags. Paged with a cursor.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_get_glossary_term
tools.description: One glossary term with description, translations per language, tags and flags.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_create_glossary_terms
tools.description: Add terms to the project glossary, e.g. brand names that must not be translated (translatable false) or words that must never be used (forbidden true).

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

terms.description: Terms, e.g. [{"term": "AnyBrand", "description": "Product name", "caseSensitive": true, "translatable": false, "forbidden": false, "translations": [], "tags": ["brand"]}]. All five flags and description are required.

tools.name: lokalise_update_glossary_terms
tools.description: Change glossary terms by id: text, description, flags, translations or tags.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.

tools.name: lokalise_list_translation_statuses
tools.description: Custom translation statuses of a project (e.g. Needs legal review) with id, title and color, for custom_translation_status_ids.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. 767946315e9866d013c1d0.08299127. For a branch append it after a colon: <project id>:<branch name>.
